id.instruksi: Robot memeriksa tubuh di laboratorium. Dengarkan nama organnya dan di mana letaknya, lalu sentuh gambarnya.
id.t-1: Lambung ada di dalam perut, tempat makanan diaduk. Mana lambungnya?
id.t-2: Otak tersimpan di dalam kepala. Sentuh otaknya!
id.t-3: Taruh tangan di dada, terasa dug-dug. Itu jantung. Mana jantungnya?
id.t-4: Saat kita menghirup udara, dada mengembang karena paru-paru. Mana paru-parunya?
id.t-5: Perut berbunyi kruk-kruk saat lapar. Mana lambung di dalam perut?
id.t-6: Mana otak, organ untuk berpikir dan mengingat?
id.t-7: Mana jantung, organ di dalam dada yang memompa darah?
id.t-8: Mana paru-paru? Ada dua, di kiri dan kanan dada.
id.t-9: Gigi dan mata terlihat dari luar. Mana organ yang tersembunyi di dalam perut?
id.t-10: Mana jantungnya? Setelah berlari, jantung berdetak cepat.
id.t-11: Mana paru-parunya? Paru-paru terisi udara saat kita menarik napas.
id.t-12: Mana otaknya? Otak bekerja saat kita menyusun puzel.

en.judul: Find the Organ Inside the Body
en.instruksi: The robot checks the body in the lab. Listen to the organ's name and where it is, then touch its picture.
en.t-1: The stomach is inside the tummy, where food gets mixed. Where is the stomach?
en.t-2: The brain is kept inside the head. Touch the brain!
en.t-3: Put your hand on your chest and feel thump-thump. That is the heart. Where is the heart?
en.t-4: When we breathe in, the chest gets bigger because of the lungs. Where are the lungs?
en.t-5: The tummy rumbles when we are hungry. Where is the stomach inside the tummy?
en.t-6: Where is the brain, the organ for thinking and remembering?
en.t-7: Where is the heart, the organ in the chest that pumps blood?
en.t-8: Where are the lungs? There are two, on the left and right of the chest.
en.t-9: Teeth and eyes can be seen from outside. Which organ is hidden inside the tummy?
en.t-10: Where is the heart? After running, the heart beats fast.
en.t-11: Where are the lungs? The lungs fill with air when we breathe in.
en.t-12: Where is the brain? The brain works when we do a puzzle.

itemCount.keterangan: jumlah gambar per pertanyaan: 3 → 4; organ dalam (otak, jantung, paru-paru, lambung) di antara bagian tubuh luar (mata, gigi, telinga, lidah)
